uge-169728.summary: CH390H Ethernet Industrial-Grade Controller Chip QFN32

blocks.text: The CH390H is an industrial-grade 10/100 Mbps Ethernet controller from WCH, integrating both an Ethernet MAC and PHY in a single IC. It provides an SPI host interface, allowing microcontrollers and embedded processors to add wired Ethernet connectivity with a compact external circuit.

The device supports 10BASE-T and 100BASE-TX, automatic negotiation, Auto-MDIX, IEEE 802.3x flow control, and includes 16 KB of internal SRAM. The CH390H is particularly suitable for embedded Ethernet applications where a compact, SPI-connected Ethernet controller is required.
No external EEPROM required for the factory MAC address
Supports IPv4/IPv6 TCP/UDP checksum generation and checking
Integrated capacitors required for the crystal oscillator
Flexible I/O voltage through dedicated VDDIO
The CH390H is specifically the SPI variant of the CH390 family; the CH390F uses an 8-bit parallel interface, while the CH390H and CH390D use SPI.
Up to 120 m transmission distance under the manufacturer’s specified conditions
The CH390H connects to the host MCU through SPI and supports:
The dedicated VDDIO supply allows the SPI interface to operate with 1.2 V, 1.8 V, 2.5 V, or 3.3 V logic, while the chip’s main supply is 3.3 V.
The CH390H is not a programmable microcontroller. It operates as an Ethernet peripheral controlled by an external MCU, MPU, or other host processor through SPI.
For example, Espressif provides a CH390H/D Ethernet driver for ESP-IDF.
The CH390H integrates both the Ethernet MAC and PHY, so a separate external Ethernet PHY is not required.
CH390H is an Ethernet controller/peripheral, not a standalone TCP/IP microcontroller. Network protocol handling is performed by the host system/software.
The chip provides a built-in unique Ethernet MAC address, eliminating the need for an external EEPROM solely for MAC-address storage.
WCH provides the official CH390 datasheet (CH390DS1) for detailed electrical characteristics, pin configuration, and reference circuitry

blocks.text: 74LS161 Synchronous 4-Bit Counter Direct Reset 5V IC DIP-16

The 74LS161 is a synchronous 4-bit binary counter designed to count clock pulses and provide a four-bit binary output. All internal flip-flops respond to the same clock signal, allowing the counter to update its outputs synchronously. It is commonly used in digital systems that require reliable pulse counting and sequential control.

The IC includes a direct, active-low clear input that resets the counter outputs to zero without waiting for a clock pulse. It also provides count-enable inputs and parallel data inputs for controlled counting and loading a preset value. The 74LS161 is suitable for digital logic projects, timing circuits, frequency division, and cascaded counter designs.

makers-3789.summary: The MAX232 is a reliable RS232-to-TTL serial level converter IC in a DIP-16 package, used to interface microcontrollers with serial communication devices.

blocks.text: MAX232 Serial Level RS232 to TTL Interface Chip Converter IC DIP-16

The MAX232 is a reliable RS232-to-TTL serial level converter IC in a compact DIP-16 package, enabling seamless interfacing between RS232 devices and TTL/CMOS logic levels. It integrates dual charge pumps to generate +10V and -10V from a single +5V supply, ensuring full RS232 voltage compliance without external components. Four drivers and receivers support bidirectional communication, with typical 300ns propagation delay for high-speed data transfer up to 120kbps. Built-in 0.1µF capacitor support simplifies design, while ESD protection up to ±15kV safeguards against transients. Operating from 0-70°C at 4.5-5.5V, it’s ideal for microcontroller projects, embedded systems, Arduino/RS485 bridges, and legacy PC interfacing. Housed in standard 16-pin DIP (19.18×6.48mm), it offers easy prototyping and drop-in replacement for older RS232 chips like 1488/1489. Perfect for IoT gateways, GPS modules, and serial debugging—delivering robust, low-power (10mA typical) performance in space-constrained applications.
Dual charge pumps generate ±10V RS232 levels from single +5V supply, eliminating bulky external transformers for compact designs.
Four drivers and four receivers enable full-duplex bidirectional communication, supporting multiple serial channels simultaneously.

Common Uses for These Jumper Wires
Linking components across a breadboard when building and testing circuits.
Connecting a breadboard to the female header sockets on an Arduino UNO Rev3.
School and university electronics labs, where students rewire circuits many times in a session.
Quick test setups for sensors, LEDs, buttons and small modules before moving to a soldered board.
Which Jumper Wire Type Do You Need?

The connector type decides where a jumper wire can plug in. Male to Male wires like this set are for connections between two female sockets, such as breadboard holes or Arduino header sockets. If one end needs to plug onto a male pin instead, choose the PH60 Male to Female Jumper Wires Set. If both ends need to plug onto male pins, choose the PH62 Female to Female Jumper Wires Set.
Can I use these wires with an Arduino?
Yes. Arduino UNO boards have female header sockets, and the male pins on these wires plug straight into them. The other end can go into a breadboard or another female socket.
Can I use them with the Raspberry Pi GPIO pins?

Not directly. The Raspberry Pi GPIO header is made of male pins, so you need a wire with a female end to connect to it. A Male to Female set is the right choice there, with the male end going into the breadboard.
Yes. The wires are joined as a ribbon and pull apart by hand, so you can use them one at a time or keep a few together as a neat bundle.
What is the difference between male to male, male to female and female to female jumper wires?

It comes down to the connector on each end. A male end has a pin that plugs into a socket, and a female end is a socket that plugs onto a pin. Pick the type based on whether the two points you're connecting are sockets, pins, or one of each.
Each wire is 20cm long, which suits most breadboard and Arduino setups on a desk.

blocks.text: NEC D8259AC-2 Processor / Microcontroller IC DIP-28

The D8259AC-2 is an interrupt controller designed to manage and prioritize multiple hardware interrupt requests for microprocessor systems. It centralizes handling of asynchronous events, reducing processor overhead by managing interrupt requests, generating vectored interrupts, and supplying a prioritized response. Internally it maintains request and service registers that track pending and serviced interrupts, enabling precise control over interrupt acknowledgement and masking.

Built for straightforward integration, the device supports cascading to expand interrupt capacity, allowing a master–slave arrangement where one master can control multiple slave controllers. Its programmable interface permits initialization and mode selection through defined control words, while its internal priority resolution supports flexible schemes to match system requirements. The chip interfaces directly with CPU interrupt acknowledge cycles to supply vector information.

Physically available in a 28-pin DIP package, the UPD8259A is compatible with TTL logic levels and standard +5V operation common to legacy microprocessor platforms. Its compact form and predictable behavior make it suitable for embedded and general-purpose systems where deterministic interrupt handling is required. Its simple programming model, clear signal timing, and support for both edge and level-triggered events simplify system design and debugging across a wide range of legacy platforms.

blocks.text: 27C128 128K (16K x 8) CMOS EPROM IC (USED LIKE NEW)

The General Instrument 27C128 is a CMOS-based ultraviolet light erasable programmable read-only memory. With a total capacity of 128K bits, it is organized as 16,384 words by 8 bits, effectively functioning as a 16-kilobyte non-volatile storage device. This architecture allows it to store firmware or permanent data for a microprocessor-based system, holding its content without power.

The device is designed for fully static operation, requiring no clocks or refresh cycles, which simplifies its integration into a system. Accessing a byte of data, whether from a change in address or when the chip is enabled, is accomplished with high speed. The CMOS design is a key characteristic, enabling the chip to consume very little power, especially in standby mode where the current drops dramatically.

Data is written to the memory through an electrical programming process that requires a higher programming voltage on the Vpp pin. The stored data can be erased entirely by exposing the quartz window on the chip package to ultraviolet light, which resets all bits to a logical ‘1’ state. The chip includes control inputs for Chip Enable and Output Enable, allowing for easy connection to a system bus and preventing bus contention.

makers-483983.summary: Compact CT-1 coil-tester from JTXTOOLS uses electromagnetic induction to quickly diagnose inductors on motherboards and mobile-PCB components.

blocks.text: JTXTOOLS CT-1 Motherboard Component Inductor and Coil Tester

Picking up the CT-1, you immediately sense that this is a tool built for a specific task: diagnosing coils and inductors on PCBs, motherboards, and small electronic modules. The form is compact, deliberately minimalist, and engineered to slide into a technician’s work-bench without fuss. During power-on, RESET is asserted when the supply voltage VDD becomes higher than 1.1 V. The LM2904 is a Dual package version of the commonly used LM741 Op-Amp, both the IC share the same electrical characteristics. This Op-Amp does not have a latch-up problem and hence is ideal to be used in voltage follower applications. It also has internal frequency compensation and short circuit protection in-built and hence requires a minimum number of components to be application ready. Because of these characteristics, these ICs are commonly found inside DVD players and Guitar amplifiers.
LM2904 IC consume very low current. So if you are looking for an Op-amp IC with all these characteristics, then this IC might be right choice for you.
As mentioned earlier this IC requires minimum number of components to be application ready. A high input impedance non-inverting application circuit diagram from LM2904 IC datasheet is shown below.

Input supply is given at the non-inverting pin while inverting pin is connected to ground through a 10k resistor. This circuit gives a closed-loop gain equal to the ratio of the sum of R1 and R2 to R1 and a closed-loop 3 dB bandwidth equal to the amplifier unity-gain frequency divided by the closed-loop gain. The gain of the circuit depends on the R1 and R2:
Set R1 to 10kΩ, and R2 to 99x the value of R1, which would be 990kΩ. Replacing the 990kΩ with a 1MΩ will result in a gain of 101, which is within the desired gain tolerance.

The 2N3053 Transistor is a general-purpose N-P-N transistor, A junction transistor is a sandwiched construction between two layers of N-type material or P-type material, depending upon the construction transistors are divided into two categories NPN transistor and PNP transistor, which are shown below. transistors are made up of silicon or germanium, depending upon the application, the applicant has to choose an appropriate one.

2N3053 is an NPN transistor so when no power is applied to the base, the collector and emitter will be left open (reverse-biased). Until positive voltage is applied to the base of the transistor, when there is a positive voltage, a small amount of current starts to flow from base to emitter and the transistor reaches it’s on state. The max gain of this transistor is 50, which determines the amplification factor of the device. The maximum base current is limited to 15mA for this device, more than that and there is a good chance it could damage the device. The collector emitter current for this device is 700mA more than 700mA could damage the device. This is a 5W-rated transistor and can be used for many different applications.

When this transistor is in biased condition, then it can allow a maximum current of 700mA with 5W power capacity across CE(Collector Emitter) Junction, this state of the transistor is called the saturation state, and driving a load that consumes more current than 700mA may damage the device. As you already may know a transistor is a current-controlled device so when the base current is removed the transistor will migrate to its off state, in this stage the transistor is working in its Cut-off Region so no current flows through the base-emitter junction.

Transistors are current-controlled devices, meaning they can be turned on or off by supplying the required base current, for the 2N3053 Transistor it is 15mA. 2N3053 is an NPN transistor which means it will be left open when no current is applied to its base, but when we apply a base voltage a small amount of base current flows through the transistor, and the transistor turns on. The simulated circuit below shows how this transistor behaves when a base current is applied to the and when no current is provided to the base.

When we turn on the transistor by supplying a required current to the base of the transistor, it will remain on unless the voltage at the base of the transistor reaches zero. The base of the transistor cannot be left floating otherwise there could be false triggering to the transistor which may lead to issues in the circuit. To resolve the issue, we need to add pulldown resistors. For example, a 10K resistor is used to pull down the base of the transistor.

Typical use includes routing data lines, selecting between memory or peripheral sources, and simple data-path multiplexing.

The BC107 is a small single NPN Transistor available in TO-18 metal can package. These transistors are age old and have been used in low noise and low signal designs. Today a lot new transistors have come as replacement for BC107, but still the transistor can be found in market for its legacy.

blocks.v: Emitter · Current Drains out through emitter, normally connected to ground

blocks.text: Available in To-18 Metal can Package
Note: Complete Technical Details can be found at the BC107 datasheet given at the end of this page.

The BC107 is a low signal NPN which is known for its low noise operations making it famously used in signal processing circuits and television receivers. The transistor is still available in market due to its legacy but you will find better modern transistors as replacement for BC107.

BC107 is a NPN transistor hence the collector and emitter will be left open (Reverse biased) when the base pin is held at ground and will be closed (Forward biased) when a signal is provided to base pin. BC107 has a gain value hfe of 50; this value determines the amplification capacity of the transistor. The maximum amount of current that could flow through the Collector pin is 100mA, hence we cannot connect loads that consume more than 100mA using this transistor.

When this transistor is fully biased then it can allow a maximum of 100mA to flow across the collector and emitter. This stage is called Saturation Region. When base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, this stage is called as the Cut-off Region.

The picture to the right shows what’s inside the servo tester module on the bottom side of the board so you’re not tempted to rip the enclosure off to see what is inside.

The 8-pin IC appears to be a microcontroller with the markings removed. There are a bunch of 470Ω resistors for providing current limiting for the three LEDs as well as the three PWM outputs. The PWM outputs each have their own current limiting resistor, but they are all driven off the same signal.

The power and ground pins on the input side pass straight through to the power and ground pins on the servo connectors with a few filtering caps thrown in. Since the servos operate at 4.8 to 6V, the input needs to be fed with a power source between 4.8V and 6V.
The input side is a 3-pin male header. Power is connected to ‘+‘ and ground is connected to ‘–‘. Current draw from the power supply will depend on the servo(s) being driven.
The ‘S’ (signal) pin on the input side is not connected to anything and can be left unconnected.
The output is a 3×3 male header.

Up to 3 servos can be connected by plugging the connectors in horizontally across the row of 3 pins. The servo brown (ground) wire goes to ‘–‘, the servo red (power) wire goes to ‘+‘ and the servo yellow/orange (signal) wire goes ‘S‘.

There are 3 modes of operation for the servo tester. The blue LEDs indicate the currently active mode and the SELECT button toggles between the different modes. When the device first powers up, the Manual mode is selected.

MAN – Manual Mode. Turning the knob controls the position of the servo. This is handy for testing the functionality of the servo in an application without having to setup an MCU with software. If a servo is connected to the elbow of a mechanical arm, the arm can be exercised through its range using the control knob.
NEUTRAL – Returns the servo to the center position.

AUTO – Runs the servo continuously through its full range left and right approximately once per second. This can be handy for testing servos over time or to automate the movement of a device such as a prop that needs to swing back and forth.

Note: This device is only designed to work with servos or as a PWM input to an ECS (Electronic Speed Control) unit. It is designed to drive a low current PWM output and simply pass power and ground through. It is not suitable to try to control DC motors directly using PWM as it cannot provide the necessary current.

blocks.text: 2WD Mini Round Double-Deck Robot Car Chassis Kit with Acrylic Frame and BO Motors

The 2WD Mini Round Double-Deck Robot Car Chassis Kit is a practical and easy-to-assemble robotic car base designed for DIY robotics, STEM education, smart car experiments, line-following projects, obstacle avoidance prototypes, wireless control cars, and microcontroller-based automation projects. Its compact round acrylic design makes it suitable for small robotic vehicles where low weight, simple assembly, and flexible module mounting are important.

This robot car chassis kit provides a strong starting platform for building a two-wheel drive robotic car. The chassis uses a transparent acrylic double-deck structure, allowing users to install motors, wheels, battery holder, controller boards, motor drivers, sensors, and wiring in an organized way. The round shape gives the platform a balanced layout, while the second deck gives extra space for electronics such as Arduino boards, Raspberry Pi boards, ESP32 modules, motor driver modules, ultrasonic sensors, infrared tracking sensors, Bluetooth modules, Wi-Fi modules, and other robotics accessories.

The 2WD Mini Round Double-Deck Robot Car Chassis Kit is especially suitable for beginners because it includes the essential mechanical parts needed to build a mobile robot base. The kit comes with two BO DC geared motors, two 65mm wheels with rubber tyres, caster wheels for support, acrylic plates, mounting brackets, screws, nuts, copper stand-offs, and assembly hardware. With these parts, users can create a stable two-wheel drive smart car chassis and then add the control electronics of their choice.

This platform is not a complete ready-to-run robot. It is a chassis kit for building a robot car base. To make it operate, the user must add a suitable control board, motor driver, battery or power supply, wiring, and programming. It can be used with popular microcontroller systems such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, STM32, and other compatible robotics controllers. For motor driving, commonly used modules such as L293D, L298N, TB6612FNG, or similar dual DC motor drivers can be used depending on the project requirements.

The included BO DC geared motors typically operate in the 3V to 6V DC range, making the kit suitable for low-voltage educational robot projects. The motor outputs drive the two side wheels, while the caster wheels help support the chassis and allow smooth movement. The encoder discs included in some batches can be used with suitable sensors to measure wheel rotation, speed, or movement feedback in more advanced robotics experiments.

The compact size of the chassis makes it easy to use on desks, classroom tables, robotics labs, and small testing areas. The overall outline size is approximately 135 × 135 × 80mm, while the round acrylic plate diameter is approximately 130mm. The additional acrylic baseboard measures approximately 135 × 75mm. These dimensions make the robot car small enough for beginner projects while still offering enough space to mount common electronic modules.

The transparent acrylic material gives the robot a clean technical appearance and makes it easier to see the assembled structure, wiring, and components. This is useful in educational environments because students can clearly understand how the motors, wheels, chassis layers, brackets, and support hardware fit together. The double-layer design also helps separate the mechanical and electronic sections of the project, improving organization and reducing messy wiring.

The 2WD Mini Round Double-Deck Robot Car Chassis Kit can be used in many robotics applications. It is suitable for building line-following robots, obstacle avoidance cars, Bluetooth-controlled robot cars, Wi-Fi smart cars, simple autonomous vehicles, sensor testing platforms, motor control experiments, school projects, robotics club activities, and prototype mobile robots. It is also useful for learning basic concepts such as motor control, wheel movement, turning behavior, speed adjustment, PWM control, sensor feedback, and mechanical assembly.

For line-following projects, users can install infrared tracking sensors under the chassis. For obstacle avoidance projects, an ultrasonic sensor can be mounted on the upper deck or front area. For wireless control, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi modules can be added. For advanced experiments, encoder discs and suitable encoder sensors can be used to study wheel rotation and movement feedback.

Because this product is a DIY chassis kit, it is recommended to assemble it carefully and avoid over-tightening the screws on the acrylic plates. Acrylic is strong enough for lightweight robotics, but excessive pressure may crack the material. It is also recommended to use the correct voltage for the BO motors and avoid connecting them directly to a microcontroller output pin. A motor driver module should be used to control motor direction and speed safely.

The 2WD Mini Round Double-Deck Robot Car Chassis Kit is a very good choice for customers who want a simple, affordable, and compact robot base for learning and experimentation. It gives makers the freedom to choose their own controller, sensors, power method, and code while providing the mechanical foundation needed to start building a smart robotic vehicle.

قلم التجليخ والتلميع الكهربائي ما آنت دي ١ هو أداة دقيقة صغيرة الحجم مصممة لأعمال التجليخ، التلميع، الصنفرة، الحفر الخفيف، النقش، التشطيب، التنظيف، والقص البسيط في المشروعات اليدوية وأعمال الصيانة الخفيفة. يتميز بتصميم رفيع يشبه القلم، مما يجعله سهل التحكم عند العمل على التفاصيل الصغيرة، خصوصًا في صيانة الموبايلات، الهوايات، الأعمال اليدوية، المجوهرات، الخشب، البلاستيك، الراتنج، الشمع، والأسطح المعدنية الخفيفة.

تم تصميم ما آنت دي ١ للمستخدم الذي يحتاج أداة دوارة صغيرة وخفيفة يمكن التحكم بها مثل القلم. المنتج يأتي مع مجموعة رؤوس متعددة، وكابل شحن، ومفتاح ألنكيه صغير لتغيير وتركيب الإكسسوارات. يدعم القلم مستويات سرعة مختلفة لاختيار السرعة المناسبة حسب طبيعة الخامة ونوع العمل. كما يحتوي على منطقة عرض ذكية توضح مستوى الطاقة، مستوى السرعة، حمل التشغيل، وتنبيه الحمل الزائد، مما يساعد المستخدم على متابعة حالة الأداة أثناء العمل.

هذا القلم الكهربائي مناسب للأعمال الدقيقة التي يصعب تنفيذها بأداة كبيرة الحجم. الصور المرسلة توضح استخدامه في التلميع، الحفر، التجليخ، التشطيب، والعمل على الأسطح الصغيرة. يمكن استخدامه مع خامات مناسبة مثل الخشب، المعادن الخفيفة، الأحجار الصغيرة، الشمع، البلاستيك، الراتنج، قطع الهوايات، بعض أجزاء أغلفة الموبايل، والأسطح التي تحتاج تشطيبًا دقيقًا. دعم رؤوس بقطر ٢.٣٥ مليمتر يجعله مناسبًا مع أنواع كثيرة من الرؤوس الصغيرة المستخدمة في الأدوات الدوارة الدقيقة.

microohm-222129.summary: R13-507 16mm 2-Pin Momentary Push Button Switch 3A 250VAC The R13-507 16mm Momentary Push Button Switch is a compact round panel-mount switch designed for temporary ON control in electrical and electronic circuits. It is a No Lock / Self-Reset push button , meaning the circuit turns ON only while the button is pressed and automatically returns to OFF when released.

blocks.text: The R13-507 16mm 2-Pin Momentary Push Button Switch is a practical and reliable round push button switch designed for applications that require a temporary electrical control signal. This switch is commonly used in control panels, electronic projects, machine control circuits, relay trigger inputs, appliance controls, testing equipment, and compact electrical boxes.

This model is a momentary no-lock push button switch. It does not stay ON after being pressed. Instead, it works only while the button is being held down. When the user presses the button, the internal contacts close and the circuit turns ON. When the button is released, the internal spring returns the button to its normal position and the circuit turns OFF again.

This makes the switch suitable for applications where a short control command is required, such as reset functions, manual trigger inputs, relay activation, start commands, test buttons, and temporary control signals. It is not the correct choice for applications that require the switch to remain ON after one press. For maintained ON/OFF switching, a self-locking or latching switch should be used instead.

The switch has a compact round structure with a plastic body, colored push button cap, threaded mounting section, rubber sealing ring, hexagonal metal nut, and 2-pin terminals. The rubber ring and fixing nut help provide a firm installation on panels and make the switch suitable for use in control boxes, instrument panels, custom enclosures, and DIY project cases.

The product is marked with 6A 125VAC / 3A 250VAC, making it suitable for control and switching applications within its rated limits. However, for motors, heaters, high-power lamps, inductive loads, or circuits with high starting current, it is recommended to use the push button as a control input for a relay, contactor, or electronic driver circuit rather than switching the load directly through the button.

The R13-507 is available in multiple colors, which helps organize panel functions clearly. Red can be used for stop, reset, alarm, or emergency indication circuits. Green can be used for start or enable functions. Blue can be used for special control functions or auxiliary inputs. Black can be used for general-purpose control or neutral panel designs.

The switch uses a standard 2-pin terminal layout, making wiring simple and direct. Because it is a momentary switch, it is commonly used with low-voltage control circuits, microcontroller projects, automation panels, industrial control inputs, testing devices, and small electronic appliances.

مفتاح الضغط اللحظي الدائري مقاس 16 مللي هو مفتاح عملي مخصص للتركيب على اللوحات والعلب الكهربائية، ويستخدم في الدوائر التي تحتاج إلى أمر تشغيل مؤقت فقط أثناء الضغط على الزر. هذا النوع يعمل بنظام الرجوع الذاتي بدون تثبيت، بمعنى أن الدائرة تعمل أثناء الضغط فقط، ثم تفصل تلقائيًا عند ترك الزر.

يتميز المفتاح بتصميم دائري مدمج، جسم بلاستيك، صامولة معدنية للتثبيت، جلدة عزل وتثبيت، ورأس زر ملون حسب الاختيار. كما يحتوي على طرفين للتوصيل، مما يجعل عملية التوصيل سهلة ومباشرة داخل لوحات التحكم والمشروعات الإلكترونية.

وظيفة هذا المفتاح هي التوصيل أثناء الضغط والفصل عند ترك الزر. في الحالة الطبيعية تكون الدائرة مفصولة، وعند الضغط على الزر يتم توصيل الدائرة، وبمجرد رفع اليد عن الزر يعود المفتاح تلقائيًا إلى وضع الفصل. لذلك فهو مناسب لأزرار إعادة التشغيل، أزرار البدء المؤقت، تشغيل الريلاي، دوائر الاختبار، أو أي دائرة تحتاج إلى إشارة تحكم مؤقتة.

المنتج متوفر كمنتج متعدد الخيارات بأربعة ألوان: الأحمر، الأسود، الأزرق، والأخضر. اختلاف اللون لا يغير الوظيفة الكهربائية للمفتاح، لكنه يساعد في تنظيم اللوحات وتمييز كل وظيفة بصريًا. يمكن استخدام الأحمر لوظائف الإيقاف أو التنبيه، الأخضر للتشغيل، الأزرق للوظائف الإضافية، والأسود للتحكم العام.

المفتاح مكتوب عليه تصنيف كهربائي 6 أمبير عند 125 فولت تيار متردد، و3 أمبير عند 250 فولت تيار متردد. ومع ذلك، يفضل استخدامه في دوائر التحكم والإشارة أو مع الريلاي والكونتاكتور، خصوصًا عند التعامل مع أحمال عالية مثل المحركات والسخانات والمصابيح الكبيرة.

Unlike round panel-mount push buttons that require a front panel hole and fixing nut, this model is designed mainly for PCB installation. blocks.text: MG995 Servo Motor Tower Pro Continuous Rotation (Full Metal Gear)

The MG995 Tower Pro Continuous Rotation Servo Motor is a high-performance, durable servo designed for applications that require full 360-degree continuous motion. Unlike standard servo motors that rotate to a specific angle (e.g., 0° to 180°), this version of the MG995 is modified to provide continuous rotation, making it ideal for wheeled robots, conveyor systems, mobile platforms, and other projects requiring bidirectional speed control.

Equipped with full metal gears, including strong brass and steel components, the MG995 is built to handle mechanical stress and heavy loads without gear wear or failure. Its robust internal structure allows for higher torque output — up to 12 kg·cm at 6V — which is particularly beneficial for mobile robotics or lifting mechanisms. The inclusion of dual ball bearings enhances smooth motion and longevity, even under frequent or high-load usage.

This servo is controlled using a PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) signal, but instead of controlling position, the pulse length controls the speed and direction of rotation. A 1.5 ms pulse stops the motor, pulses shorter than 1.5 ms make it spin in one direction, and pulses longer than 1.5 ms make it spin in the opposite direction. The further the pulse deviates from 1.5 ms, the faster the motor spins.

The MG995 continuous rotation servo operates at a voltage range of 4.8V to 7.2V, with a typical operating speed of around 0.14–0.20 sec/60° equivalent, depending on voltage. Its standard 3-wire interface (orange for signal, red for VCC, and brown for GND) makes it easily compatible with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and RC controllers.
In summary, the MG995 Continuous Rotation Servo Motor is a powerful, reliable, and affordable solution for motion control in DIY robotics, smart automation, and RC-based projects.
Full 360° Continuous Rotation: Moves freely in either direction — ideal for wheels, conveyor belts, or rotating platforms.
Speed and Direction Control via PWM: Easily control how fast and in which direction it spins using simple pulse signals.
Strong and Durable Metal Gears: Built with full metal gears that last longer and handle more stress than plastic ones.
Powerful Torque for Heavy Loads: Can move or drive heavier objects with ease — great for mobile robots or lifting systems.
Stable and Smooth Operation: Dual ball bearings reduce noise and friction, giving a smooth and reliable motion.
Plug-and-Play with Arduino & RC: Connects easily to common platforms like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or RC controllers — no complicated setup.
Stays in Motion Until You Tell It to Stop: Unlike regular servos, it keeps spinning as long as you send the right signal.
Compact and Fits Anywhere: Small enough to fit in tight spaces while still offering strong output.
Affordable and Beginner-Friendly: Offers high performance for a low cost, making it ideal for students, hobbyists, and prototype projects.
Great for DIY Robotics and Smart Projects: Perfect for smart cars, automatic doors, animatronics, and other creative builds.

مجموعة PPD WONENG Opening Tool 7 Pieces هي طقم عملي مخصص لأعمال صيانة وفتح الموبايلات والتابلت. المنتج معمول للفنيين اللي محتاجين تحكم أفضل أثناء فك الشاشة، وفتح الفريم، وفصل المادة اللاصقة، والوصول للكابلات، والتعامل مع خطوات الشغل القريبة من البطارية أثناء الصيانة. وجود 7 قطع داخل المجموعة يدي المستخدم تنوع أفضل في أشكال أدوات الفتح، وده يخليها أنسب للتعامل مع أنواع مختلفة من الأجهزة ونقاط الفتح المختلفة أثناء الشغل.
✅ المجموعة مناسبة لأعمال صيانة الموبايلات وصيانة التابلت في الحالات اللي تحتاج فتح دقيق حوالين الشاشة، والحواف، والأجزاء الملزوقة، والمناطق الداخلية.
✅ تقدر تستخدمها في فك الشاشة، وفتح الفريم، وفصل اللاصق، والوصول للكابلات، ودعم فك البطارية أثناء الصيانة.

✅ الأدوات مناسبة للشغل الدقيق في المساحات الضيقة اللي تحتاج حركة ثابتة وتحكم أفضل أثناء الفك.
✅ تصميم المقبض الملفوف بيدي مسكة أريح وثبات أفضل أثناء الشغل التفصيلي على الأجهزة.

الطقم ده مفيد جدًا في بيئات الصيانة اللي فيها أجهزة مختلفة، لأن كل جهاز ممكن يحتاج طريقة دخول مختلفة. في شغل بيحتاج طرف رفيع للدخول، وفي شغل تاني يحتاج سطح أعرض أو شكل مختلف يساعد على فصل الأجزاء بشكل أفضل. وجود أكثر من قطعة في نفس المجموعة بيسهّل الشغل ويدي مرونة أكبر أثناء فك الجهاز والوصول للمكونات الداخلية.

كمان هو اختيار مناسب لورش الصيانة، ومراكز الخدمة، وطاولات الفنيين اللي بتتعامل بشكل يومي مع صيانة الموبايلات والتابلت. سواء كان الاستخدام في رفع الشاشة، أو فتح الفريم، أو إزالة اللاصق، أو الوصول إلى أجزاء داخلية بتحكم أفضل، فالمجموعة دي بتوفر تنوع عملي يخدم الشغل اليومي.

The Turbidity Sensor with Board Module is a ready-to-use water-clarity kit that combines an optical turbidity probe, a compact signal board, and a 3-wire harness. Running on 5 V, it exposes both analog (≈0–4.5 V) and digital (threshold) outputs, so you can log a continuous turbidity voltage or trigger events when cloudiness crosses your setpoint. It’s ideal for filtration monitoring, aquariums, hydroponics, dishwashers, and STEM projects. (Focus keyword used: Turbidity Sensor with Board Module.)
💧 Dual outputs — analog 0–4.5 V for continuous readings + digital high/low with an adjustable threshold.
🔋 5 V supply, low current — typical draw below 40 mA (max); plug-friendly with Arduino/ESP.
🎛️ Sensitivity trimmer — blue potentiometer sets the digital trip point in seconds.
🧠 Optical IR measurement — measures light transmission/scatter correlated with suspended solids.
🧩 Plug-and-play — probe to board via keyed 3-pin connector; board to controller via 4-pin header.
🧪 Fast response — typically <500 ms to step changes.
🌡️ Wide temperature — module works from −20 to +90 °C (immerse only the optical end of the probe).
Kit contents: Optical turbidity probe + signal board + cable.
Analog output: ~0–4.5 V proportional to turbidity (higher voltage → clearer water on most batches).
Digital output: D0 active/inactive by threshold (set using the trimmer).
Output logic levels: 0/5 V TTL compatible.
Board size: approx 38.6 × 22.1 mm; mounting hole φ≈3.3 mm.
Measuring range: 0–1000 NTU (Assumed — common for this form factor; calibrate for your medium).
Controller header (board ↔ MCU): 4-pin: VCC, A0, D0, GND.
Indicators: Power LED and Level LED.
A0 → analog input on your MCU (e.g., Arduino A0)
D0 → digital input/interrupt (fires when turbidity crosses your threshold)
Probe lead: mates to the board via the included 3-pin plug (Sensor+, Sensor−, V− handled on-board).
Keep the probe slot vertical to prevent air bubbles.
Add 100 nF decoupling at the controller side if your readings are noisy.
Route the probe cable away from pumps/motors to reduce interference.
Board: ~38.6 × 22.1 mm (some batches show ~30.1 × 20.1 mm — functionally identical).
🔧 Set the digital limit: With clean water, rotate the trimmer until the Level LED just turns OFF; add turbidity and adjust to your preferred trip point.
📈 Map A0 to NTU: Record A0 voltage for a clear sample and a cloudy sample; compute a linear map (two-point). For better accuracy, take multiple points and fit a curve.
🧼 Care for optics: Rinse the probe after use; avoid scratching the clear windows.
🧯 Immersion rule: The top of the probe is not sealed — submerge the optical end only.
🧪 STEM labs and demos with Arduino/ESP32
🚰 DIY water column studies (inlet vs outlet)
✅ Each module powers up with both LEDs verified; A0 changes with sample clarity and D0 toggles at the set threshold before packing.

Use only on low-voltage (5 V) circuits.
Do not allow water into the probe’s top or onto the board; strain-relieve the cable.

most-42270.summary: The MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter is a compact 2000-count electrical testing instrument. It measures AC current up to 400A without disconnecting the circuit. In addition, it measures AC/DC voltage, resistance, continuity, and diodes using the supplied test probes.

blocks.text: The MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter is a compact and practical measuring instrument for electrical maintenance, installation, and troubleshooting. It measures AC current by clamping around a single insulated conductor. Therefore, you can check current without cutting the wire or connecting the meter in series with the circuit.

The clamp meter provides three AC current ranges: 20A, 200A, and 400A. In addition, the supplied test probes allow you to measure DC voltage up to 600V and AC voltage up to 450V. The meter can also test resistance, continuity, and diodes.
MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter Features

The MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter is suitable for electricians, maintenance technicians, students, and DIY users. It can help test electrical panels, lighting circuits, appliances, power supplies, workshop equipment, and AC loads.
Moreover, the compact body makes it easy to carry inside a toolbox. The rotary selector also provides quick access to the required measurement mode.

For AC current measurement, clamp the meter around only one conductor. Do not clamp around both the live and neutral wires together because their magnetic fields cancel each other and produce an incorrect reading.
The clamp section measures AC current only. It does not measure DC current through the clamp. However, the test probes can measure both AC and DC voltage.

Always select the correct function and range before starting. Also, inspect the meter and probes for damage. Never exceed the specified measurement limits, and use extra caution when working on live electrical circuits.

blocks.text: The 30W Nickel Soldering Iron Tip is a general-purpose replacement part for compatible 30W pencil-type soldering irons. It provides a clean working surface for melting solder and transferring heat to electronic components, wires and PCB pads.

Over time, a soldering iron tip can become oxidized, pitted or difficult to tin. As a result, heat transfer becomes slower and solder may no longer flow correctly. Replacing the worn tip can restore the soldering iron’s performance and make everyday repair work easier.

The nickel-plated surface helps protect the tip against oxidation and normal surface wear. In addition, it improves durability compared with an untreated tip when the product is used and maintained correctly.

blocks.text: The main functions and controls of BLTouch are the same as the usual auto bed leveling sensor, consisting of RC servo and microswitch. Thus, BLTouch can be applied on almost every board.

BLTouch is fulfilled with simple structure and high precision by using progressively designed solenoid and hall sensors. It aims for user convenience and enjoyable printing by adding many smart functions, such as self-test, alarm, alarm release & Touch Switch mode, Blue LED for servo signal indicating and Z-probe (Zmin) Testing.​
BLTouch consists of Atmel ATtiny13A, solenoid, and a push pin.​

Innovative Solenoid: Ultra Power Saving In an idle state, while the push-pin is pulled out or retracted, there is no electric current flowing on the solenoid. Standby electric current in the whole device is below the average of 15mA on working state, but while the pin is moving, in a sudden about 100ms, under 300mA flows in the device. Low power consumption even drops joule heating, and it prevents heart problems.

Hall Sensor: Free Bed Selection BLTouch does not use either optical or proximity(inductive/capacitive) sensors. BLTouch is controlled by the hall effect, providing high precision. Thus, the bed material can be freely selected.
Optimized structure: Larger Build Size BLTouch is a small, and technology-intensive device. Build size can be set larger than other existing auto bed leveling sensors.
Easy to Use: BLTouch uses existing RC Servo motor signals intactly, so just plug BLTouch on the same pins after removing the servo motor.
Z-probe output: Logic free (default open-drain) or 5 V logic voltage

The 2-Channel 5V Relay Module (Optocoupled, for Arduino/PIC/ARM) is a compact two-relay interface board that lets microcontrollers such as Arduino, PIC, ARM, AVR and DSP boards switch higher-voltage or higher-current loads. Each channel uses an optocoupler-isolated SPDT relay so the control-side logic stays fully separated from the switched circuit.
Two Independent Channels: Controls two separate AC or DC loads from one small board.
Optocoupler Isolation: Keeps microcontroller logic pins electrically isolated from the relay coil and switched load.
5V Logic Trigger: Compatible with standard 3.3V/5V microcontroller outputs including Arduino, PIC, ARM, AVR and DSP.
10A Relay Rating: Each SPDT relay is rated up to 10A at 250VAC or 10A at 30VDC.
Screw Terminal Outputs: NO/COM/NC screw terminals make load wiring quick and solder-free.
Compact Layout: Small footprint fits easily inside enclosures or alongside other modules on a project board.
A handy building block for automation, remote switching and any beginner-to-intermediate project that needs to control mains or DC loads from a microcontroller.
